summary: Backend + frontend regression for Jewish sacred texts restructure PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases green (auth guard, 8 categories seeded/ordered/fielded, /categories/cat_tanakh/books returns 5 Books of Moses with correct order & category_id, chapters + verses reachable by new IDs ch_bereishit_1..3 / ch_shemot_1 / ch_shemot_3, bookmark CRUD with new IDs). Frontend (mobile 390x844 via injected session_token): Library screen renders all 8 category cards in a 2-column grid (each ~177x155px) with colored accent bar on top, Georgia 26px title, gray description. Tapping Tanakh → /category/cat_tanakh shows header (accent bar + title + description) and 5 book cards (Bereishit/Shemot/Vayikra/Bamidbar/Devarim) with cover color, book icon, Hebrew title (Georgia), and English name below. Tapping Bereishit → /book/book_bereishit lists 3 chapters (Creation/The Garden/The Fall). Tapping Creation → /chapter/ch_bereishit_1 shows Hebrew original (בְּרֵאשִׁית …) side-by-side with English translation. All new IDs work. Deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents warnings still emitted (non-blocking, carry-over from iteration 1).

issues: Category cards have no visible padding on left/right beyond the FlatList container (12px). Cards touch each other horizontally with only 12px column gap; visually matches reference. Description clipped at 4 lines — acceptable but longer descriptions (Talmud, Halakhah) get cut, verify against spec.

Book cards render icon and title stacked vertically (icon top-left, title+author below). Reference intent looks landscape which is preserved. Icon-to-title vertical gap works well; no action needed unless a horizontal layout is required.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Emitted from /app/frontend/app/category/[id].tsx:174-178 (bookCard shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) and /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx (loginButton, iconContainer).
React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from expo-router/Tabs internals — safe to ignore or update expo-router.

action_items: (Optional cleanup, carry-over) Migrate deprecated shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/app/category/[id].tsx bookCard styles (lines 174-178) and /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx to silence RNW warnings.

chapter/[id].tsx still loads ALL books then iterates each book's chapters to find the current chapter's parent (loadChapterData). This is O(N) network calls per chapter open. Consider a backend endpoint like GET /api/chapters/{chapter_id} that returns chapter + book to avoid the N+1 fan-out.
book/[id].tsx currently calls GET /api/books (full list) then filters client-side to find the book — add GET /api/books/{book_id} on backend for efficiency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed-data is idempotent guarded on categories.count > 0 — good.
Category model correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection ({"_id": 0}) on all reads.
All new IDs (cat_*, book_bereishit..devarim, ch_bereishit_1..3, ch_shemot_1/3, v_*) are consistent between DB seed and frontend routes.
Frontend still uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — protected var respected.

testID attributes present on category cards (category-card-<id>) and book cards (book-card-<id>) — added since iter 1. Chapter tap works via text-based selection; consider adding testID='chapter-card-{chapter_id}' on /book/[id].tsx TouchableOpacity for future automated tests.

Placeholder chapters for non-Bereishit/Shemot books have verse_count=0 and no verses seeded — expected per current data set, but chapter/[id].tsx will show 'No verses available' for those which is handled correctly.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing seeded categories/books/chapters/verses (idempotent /api/seed-data). Inserted test user user_id=test_user_qa with session token TEST_TOKEN_QA_ITER2 (7-day expiry) in MongoDB for authenticated API + UI testing. Test-created bookmark is deleted at end of test flow. Session/user left in DB for reuse by next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: inject via localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('TEST_TOKEN_QA_ITER2')) then reload. Mongo user_sessions has this token valid for 7 days for user_id=test_user_qa. Backend endpoints all require Bearer auth via that token. Frontend routes: / (library, 8 categories), /category/{category_id}, /book/{book_id}, /chapter/{chapter_id}. Book IDs are prefixed book_*, chapter IDs ch_*, verse IDs v_*. Only Bereishit (ch1-3) and Shemot (ch1 & ch3) have verses; other Torah books have placeholder chapters with verse_count=0.
